user_query: I want to plan a surprise birthday party for my friend. Can you help me find party venues in her city? Additionally, could you generate a list of decoration ideas using the url API? It would be great if you could also provide me with a translation of the decoration ideas in Spanish and French.

TaskList.description: Find party venues in the friend's city.
Generate a list of decoration ideas using a URL API.
Translate the decoration ideas into Spanish.
Translate the decoration ideas into French.
